added.title: Environmental Health Safety Specialist
added.description:
Role and Responsibilities

The EHS Specialist will work closely with management in directing occupational health and safety programs at the plant level while ensuring compliance with Federal, State, and local regulations and standards. Must be able to provide support to departments to take a proactive approach to ensure compliance. As a team member there will be an equal level of accountability, along with the management team, in promoting and accomplishing the health and safety initiatives at the plant level.
Assist in the developing, implementing, monitoring and supporting site EHS policies/programs/procedures to protect the health and safety or employees, and the environment
Provide regular support to maintain compliance with applicable EHS legislation, permits and standards.
Work with management and others on the investigation of incidents, including “near-misses” to identify root causes and the appropriate management/mitigation of hazards
Assist in managing and ensuring proper reporting of incidents, and adherence to Incident Investigation Reporting Process.
Ability to work collaboratively with others to evaluate hazardous conditions and practices, including managing JHAs to develop and implement hazard control practices and programs.
Monitor and assist in managing PPE programs and supplies.
Maintain and share incident/accident reporting and statistics.
Assist in overseeing environmental programs/procedures and reporting, including hazardous waste, regulatory reporting, SWPPP, air permit requirements and air and wastewater discharges if applicable.
Manage training programs and activities, including documentation and tracking of completion rates, assignment matrixes as well as arranging for supplemental activities as necessary.
Provide EHS training for new employees as part of the on-boarding process.
To ensure efficiency, participate in cost-control efforts, manufacturing improvement committees, and the like.
Conduct safety training such as forklift, respirator fit-tests and the like.
Conduct department safety inspections on a routine basis, including regular/daily walk rounds.
Provide monthly/quarterly reports to management.
Maintain weekly/monthly safety training documentation.
Perform safety and environmental audits and inspect facilities, machinery, and safety equipment to identify and address potential hazards.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Safety, Engineering, or related field preferred or equivalent years of experience in a manufacturing environment.
Strong verbal, written, analytical, and persuasive skills and the ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization.

Required Skills

Confident self-starter who is able to work both alone and as part of several teams.
Ability to build trust and confidence across all levels of the organization.
Excellent communication skills, including verbal and written.
Thorough knowledge of applicable regulations and standards (OSHA, NFPA).
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

Pre-employment requirements

Background check
Pre-employment screening

added.title: Water Quality Sales Consultant
added.description:
Why Join Culligan?

Culligan is a leader in water treatment technology, providing innovative solutions to improve the quality of life through better water. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on people’s health and well-being, while working in a dynamic and supportive environment.

Position Description

Take daily ownership of your territory and be accountable for "hunting" for additional business opportunities while also servicing company-provided leads
Assess prospects' needs, conduct in-home water tests, and present tailored solutions to homeowners to address their concerns
Utilize follow-up techniques with customers that previously purchased to inquire about additional equipment opportunities as well as referral offerings
Build trust and long-term relationships with homeowners
Partner with service and installation teams to provide a seamless customer experience
Grow your pipeline through referrals, networking, and community involvement
Track your activity and results to stay aligned with your goals

Job Description

The Household Sales Representative will analyze customers’ water composition, design water treatment solutions, make sales presentations, and build solid, long-lasting relationships within customers’ homes in your assigned territory. In addition. you will be given company leads and marketing support to help build your territory.

Sales Representative Qualifications

A valid driver’s license
BS degree preferred with an emphasis in Sales or Marketing along with 1+ year of sales experience (relevant experience will be considered in place of degree)
Proven track record of residential sales experience is preferred.
Community involvement.
Excellent time management, telephone, and presentation skills.

You will receive formal training to prepare you for a successful career in sales with potential career advancement opportunities!

Salary & Benefits

This is a commission-based position. The expected total annual compensation for this role ranges from $80,000 to $125,000, depending on individual performance. This compensation plan is designed to offer strong income potential for motivated, high-performing individuals. Actual Earnings: Actual compensation may vary based on sales performance
Monthly vehicle allowance
Health insurance, dental, vision, disability, life, insurances plus matching 401k.
